Thank you to the colleagues who gave their time to serve on the GIScRG committee. Browse the annual returns and records of committee appointments dating back to 2002.

[History of GIScRG](history.qmd) · [Current committee](people.qmd) · [Annual committee returns](#annual-committee-returns) · [Early committee records](#early-committee-records)

## Early committee records {#early-committee-records}

### April 2015 {#agm-2015}

The minutes of 17 April record the following outgoing officers and the ordinary members who vacated their roles at the handover.

<!-- GIScRG AGM Minutes 2015.docx, item 5. The name Michail Pavlis follows the attendance list and 2014 AGM papers. -->

| Role | Committee members |
| --- | --- |
| Chair | Alex Singleton |
| Secretary and treasurer | Michail Pavlis |
| Prizes and awards | Joana Barros |
| Ordinary members | Nick Malleson, Seraphim Alvanides |

The AGM elected Nick Malleson as chair. The new committee is listed in the [2015–16 return](#committee-2015-16).

## Help complete the archive {#help-complete-the-archive}

We would particularly welcome the minutes of the April 2013 AGM and fuller records for 2008–11 and 2013–15.

If you have a committee list, annual report or AGM minutes, or if you spot an error, please [email the group](mailto:giscience.rgs@gmail.com).
